- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] Assistant provides 7 steps to incorporate tablets with ordering capabilities into Coffee Rock Bagel:

  4. Integrate the tablet ordering system with your current POS system.
  5. Promote the new ordering system to customers.
  6. Monitor and analyze performance.
  7. Continuously improve and refine the system.
